patch_instances_context: use patch_instances context manager to replace Instances with a scriptable TorchScript class for a given set of fields
patch_builtin_len_context: use patch_builtin_len context manager to patch len calls in detectron2 modules to use __len__ for tracing compatibility
freeze_training_mode_context: use freeze_training_mode context manager to annotate training attributes as constants so TorchScript can prune unused codepaths
gen_instance_class: generate a TorchScript-compatible scripted Instances class definition from a dictionary of field names and types
patch_nonscriptable_classes: apply patches to ResNet, FPN, and StandardROIHeads to make them compatible with TorchScript compilation
